name: Lucy
title: Read the Entire Harry Potter Series
blurb: Seven books. 4,100 pages. One very determined reader. Lucy is taking on the whole Harry Potter series before the clock runs out on 2026.

milestones.desc: Finish Book 4 - the first really big one.

milestones.title: Order Member
milestones.desc: Finish Book 5 - the longest book in the series.

milestones.title: Mischief Managed
milestones.desc: Finish Book 7 and the whole series. GRAND PRIZE!

sideQuests.title: Save $20 for My Own Website
sideQuests.desc: Lucy is saving up $20 of her own money to buy the domain name for her very own website. Every savings milestone unlocks a website-building session with Dad.

milestones.title: First Dollar
milestones.desc: Brainstorm website names together and check which ones are available.

milestones.title: Five Bucks
milestones.desc: Sketch the homepage on paper - what goes where?

milestones.title: Halfway There
milestones.desc: Pick the colors, fonts, and a theme for the site.

milestones.title: Domain Day!
milestones.desc: Buy the domain with her own money and launch the site!

ideas: Watch each movie as a family right after finishing its book
Read one chapter out loud to Fletcher (or Dad)
Draw a favorite scene from each book
Take a family trivia quiz after each book - Lucy writes the questions
Try a recipe from the books (pumpkin juice, anyone?)
